metadata.title: The Healthy Bite - Omya Personal Care
metadata.description: The Healthy Bite On June 20th, Intermountain West SCC hosted the inaugural US edition of Omya’s The Healthy Bite in Salt Lake City, Utah. The event brought together a diverse group of formulators, manufacturers, suppliers, and dental professionals. With nearly 100 people in attendance, The Healthy Bite provided a platform for attendees from various backgrounds to share knowledge, engage in meaningful discussions, and forge new […]
